system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan. The plan was tuned by search together with a default way of using the hero and the two spells (Rain of Fire and reinforcements), so changing that default usually makes things worse; intervene only when the situation on screen calls for it. Winning comes first, then keeping lives. Reply with exactly one option label from the list.
options: Keep the default for the coming wave (the hero holds its start point; the spells are used as tuned).
Intervene for the coming wave: send the hero and/or hold the spells for a specific threat.
